concerns.text: Success metric for SC‑002 (RAM/CPU usage against GitHub Actions limits) is not covered by any task. No task logs or validates resource consumption; the plan references a ‘resource validator’ but no corresponding task (e.g., T00X) exists.

The implementation plan includes a ‘Data Availability Check’ phase that verifies the OpenNeuro dataset is present locally. No task in tasks.md implements this check; the closest is T002 which downloads data, but the plan’s manual prerequisite is not represented by any task.

SC‑001 requires recording the proportion of successfully generated salience maps. T003 generates maps and metadata but does not explicitly compute or store the success proportion metric; no separate task records this statistic.
